scope: Offline static evidence; no firmware modification or hardware access

firmware.architecture: AArch64 ELF64 little-endian; no section headers required

verification.method: Bounded ELF program-header mapping, whole-image SHA256, exact ordered allowlists and handler byte hashes
verification.paired_initialization_audit: The command also verifies osm-tz-initialization-audit.json function hashes, descriptor decoding, source-block hashes, v2 parameter values and OSMTZContract.h constants.

read.return: x0=0; x1=32-bit read value or zero if denied

write.return: x0=0 even if denied; denied writes do not access the target

abi.function_id_mask: 0x3f00ffff in monitor dispatcher; atomic/64-bit flags do not change this allowlist
abi.availability: Service availability is independent of whether a particular register is permitted
dispatcher_evidence: 0x146823f8 stores zero to saved x0 after WRITE
0x14682400..0x1468240c invokes READ, truncates to 32 bits, stores x0=0/x1=value

conditional_table.gate_evidence: 0x14681314..0x14681324 loads a word then extracts bits15:8; caller0x14683a04 compares to1
conditional_table.interpretation: Exact hardware-version field branch; no board-ID condition appears in this handler

allowlist.other_write_special_case: 0x01fd3000 low-nibble-zero writes are suppressed when byte_1c006ba0 equals1; this does not involve OSM

denial_evidence.read: 0x14683a68 branches around LDR W0,[X19]; denied path0x14683a74 sets W0=0
denial_evidence.write: 0x14683980 branches around STR W19,[X20]; both paths reach MOV W0,WZR at0x146839b4
denial_evidence.consequence: SCM status success cannot establish address permission; readback of zero cannot prove a zero write occurred

osm_findings.old_marker_read_result: All eleven markers are excluded from both tables; this firmware returns success/value0 for every marker
osm_findings.lower_threshold_write_result: Silent no-op on both clusters; these writes in Xiaomi clock-osm.c do not prove this firmware accepts them
osm_findings.safe_inference: A rejected marker read cannot show that TZ omitted initialization
osm_findings.direct_mmio: Not established by this SCM whitelist audit. Do not bypass it with direct nonsecure reads without separate xPU/access evidence.
osm_findings.initialization_evidence: docs/power/osm-tz-initialization-audit.json reproduces v2 table selection, inherited values, descriptor contents and source-block hashes.
osm_findings.completion_limit: The eight SCM-readable boot values precede fallible protected post-table setup. The original caller discards its failure return, so matching these values cannot distinguish partial initialization from full completion.
osm_findings.unreadable_tail_state: Both banks' +0x404, +0x410 and +0x1050 are excluded from both SCM tables. +0x1050=0x179d4020 is written at the examined success tail, but direct nonsecure read permission has not been established.
osm_findings.retained_prerequisite: Protected post-initialization success remains a stock-bootchain prerequisite; this offline profile and runtime boot-value match do not independently prove it.

source_cross_reference: docs/power/reference/xiaomi-clock-osm.c:2072-2092 issues SCM writes to55..58 and32 without checking per-address acceptance

build/usb/reference/bsp/trustzone_images/core/securemsm/trustzone/qsee/include/tz_syscall_pub.h:2313-2366 documents the IO service IDs/parameters; actual pinned firmware silently denies disallowed addresses
